card.name: Counting cases: one patient, one instance
card.fires_on: The noun right after a small count such as one, both, three, or 4 of 4 when reporting how many people or cases had an event. Examples are patient, case, instance, people and man.

modes.label: Noun after a count
modes.description: A count word such as one, both or three is followed by patient, case, instance or people.
modes.example: there was one case of lymphoma among 2,657 Cimzia-treated patients and one<< case>> of Hodgkin's

modes.label: Reference back to a small group
modes.description: A word such as all, that or both points back to the few patients just mentioned.

card.writes: It seems to push toward words that single out or point to one individual or case, though the listed tokens are mixed and hard to read.
card.plain: It lights up on the noun after a small number, as in 'one case' or 'both patients', when a report singles out a few individuals.
